messages:
jade_sales: FYI we have a timed procurement from BetaFin — they want an expedited review for a POC with a $75k convertible commit and a 25% early-term discount. Can deal desk do <12h?

sam_dealdesk: 12h is tight but we have a fast-path if fields are set correctly. What exactly are they requesting (discount %, term, convertibility)?

jade_sales: 25% for first 90 days, then 10% after conversion. Convertible commit: $75k initial, converts to $300k if they sign enterprise. They want approvals in 12 business hours.

nora_revops: Please populate CPQ fields so automation triggers: bf_fast_sla = "12h_business", bf_commit_usd = 300000, bf_initial_commit = 75000, bf_discount_pct = 25, bf_convertible = "true". Tag opp: POC-BETA.

sam_dealdesk: Also add free-text bf_pricing_justification = "Strategic finance partner; Q2 marquee reference" and bf_escalation = "sam_dealdesk". That will route to the fast queue.

kevin_eng: Devops note: staging credentials require signed NDA. We can provision ephemeral tokens after quote has bf_initial_commit set and legal confirmation. No blockers in code.

legal_bot: Automated check: missing field bf_pricing_justification. Upload draft terms to /contracts/urgent and set bf_legal_priority = "high" to flag.

sam_dealdesk: I'll update the workflow: when bf_fast_sla == "12h_business" route to queue dealdesk_fast, notify head_rev and svp_sales, set SLA = 12h. If bf_commit_usd >= 250000 require exec signoff.

nora_revops: I'll create the CPQ picklists now and run smoke test. ETA 3pm PT.

jade_sales: I'll push the opportunity and ask BetaFin to accept the NDA template today. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

sam_dealdesk: Once fields exist I'll trigger a dummy quote to confirm notifications and SLA timer. Leave this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
